sentences.text: Ryan McInerney, 49, became CEO of Visa Inc. in 2023, having joined the company in 2013 and previously served as President of Visa's global businesses.
Before Visa, he was CEO of consumer banking at JPMorgan Chase and, earlier, a principal at McKinsey in the firm's retail banking and payments practices.

sentences.quote: The most consistent thread in executive backgrounds prior to joining Visa is major financial institutions and strategy consulting (particularly JPMorgan and McKinsey), with big tech as a secondary feeder. In short, management is long-tenured and deeply domain specialized.
sentences.text: His background reflects the broader pattern among Visa's senior leadership, where major financial institutions and strategy consulting are the most common prior experience, making for a long-tenured and deeply domain-specialized management team.

sentences.quote: Capital allocation priorities include 1) reinvesting back into the business for future growth (organic and inorganic) and 2) returning excess capital to shareholders through dividends and share buybacks. Strategic M&A is disciplined and bolt-on in nature.
sentences.text: Under his leadership, capital allocation centers on reinvesting in the business, both organically and through disciplined bolt-on M&A such as the $1bn Pismo acquisition in 2024, and returning excess capital via dividends and buybacks.
